recentItems.title: Businesses Count Losses After Mudslide in Nepal's Trishuli Valley
recentItems.description:
Businesses in Nepal's Trishuli Valley are assessing their losses after an ice and rock avalanche triggered a mudslide on Aug. 26, which killed more than 1,000 people and left thousands missing, and destroyed shops, homes and infrastructure, with rebuilding costs estimated at up to 5 billion U.S. dollars.
